title: Grateful Dead Live at Merriweather Post Pavilion on 1984-06-26
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Michael Hessberg's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: High‑quality audience recording praised for clearer sound than the boomy Pauline 421 source
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates this recent Me‑80 pull as the best available audience source, noting it sounds clearer and less boomy than the Pauline 421 tape. No comments are made about the musical performance itself.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single, brief review was provided; it is positive about the recording quality but offers no insight into the show, so rating leans on the strong audio endorsement.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer finds this Me‑80 audience pull clearer and less boomy than the Pauline 421 source; no specific issues reported.
